$help: How the site's emails are routed. The sender reads this file from GitHub on every request, so a saved change applies within a minute.

mode: "test" sends every practice notice, and every kit reader's reply, to the test inbox of whoever runs the sender, and marks each notice's subject; "live" uses the practice mailbox below. The kit email always goes to the person who asked for it.
The sender's own identity (the From line) and its test inbox are not here: they belong to the deployment, not the repo (mail/README.md, "Deployment").

kit.allowedDomains must match sellerGate.allowedDomains in site/data/config.js (the checker compares them). kit.perAddressPerDay and limits.perHour cap sends, so the form cannot be used to flood anyone.
